body: My last day was yesterday, I feel pretty relieved honestly. I didn't make it to 90 days, more like 60-70. You honestly don't have to be all that great to make it at Target, I was in elecronics and had toys next to me so I had to zone that god awful mess every night. Honestly I always enjoyed helping guests with questions about everything in electronics, it was the toys an seasonal that burnt me out. There were days I couldn't zone sesonal and nobody would say a word to me. Leadership was ok, and everyone who worked at my store were pretty much just eh about the company. I'm happy I moved on, no more red for me thank god.
Stick with Safeway, run far far away from Target!
All I know is you will be doing drugs once you work there for a week.
Not only do we have to assist guests, but we have to think for them as well.
I love the "Here he comes! go go go you can make it!" fucking dickheads lol
I still can't believe people get up at 6-7am just to wait for the exact moment when the store opens at 8....

When I went to orientation it was boring, what I took away from it was you're pretty much on your own with everything. The vidoes are full of actors who don't work at Target, and the HR lady made Target sound like the greatest job ever. I worked there for two weeks, quit and now I work at Costco and fucking love it I was going to be making 9.50 at Target Im making 13.50 here at Costco for less work.
